features.quote: Step + token caps*: hard bounds on cost per run
features.justification_quote: hard bounds on cost per run

features.quote: A run stops when: the model emits DONE/GIVE_UP, the step cap is reached, the token budget is exceeded
features.justification_quote: Fewer steps starves the spiral... more wastes tokens

features.quote: Terminal tokens*: give the model a clean exit (GIVE_UP)
features.justification_quote: so "degraded" is distinguishable from "honestly gave up."
